title: Refactor Naming Conventions
problem_statement: Current naming conventions do not follow modern standards, impacting readability and maintainability.
risk_if_unaddressed: Continued difficulty in maintaining and understanding the codebase.
suggested_approach: Refactor all form and module names to use PascalCase.
success_criteria: All form and module names follow PascalCase.

title: Replace Deprecated ActiveX Controls
problem_statement: The application uses deprecated ActiveX controls that are not compatible with modern systems.
risk_if_unaddressed: Potential incompatibility with future operating systems and security vulnerabilities.
suggested_approach: Identify modern equivalents or alternatives for each ActiveX control and replace them.
success_criteria: All ActiveX controls are replaced with modern equivalents.
